# {.tabset}

`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')`

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(ezRun)
ezLoadPackage("DT")
wddir <- "."
param <- ezLoadRobj("param")

## Discover per-sample output directories (those containing a DGE matrix)
sampleDirs <- list.dirs(wddir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
sampleDirs <- sampleDirs[sapply(sampleDirs, function(d) {
  dir.exists(file.path(wddir, d, "DGE_filtered"))
})]
```

## Overview

This report summarizes the [Parse Biosciences split-pipe](https://support.parsebiosciences.com/)
run for **`r param$name`**.

- Kit: **`r param$kit`**, chemistry: **`r param$chemistry`**
- Reference: **`r param$refBuild`**
- Biological samples: **`r paste(sampleDirs, collapse=", ")`**

```{r aggSummary}
aggFn <- file.path(wddir, "agg_sample_summary.csv")
if (file.exists(aggFn)) {
  agg <- read.csv(aggFn, check.names = FALSE)
  DT::datatable(
    agg,
    caption = "agg_sample_summary.csv",
    options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
} else {
  cat("No agg_sample_summary.csv found.\n")
}
```

```{r zipLink, results='asis'}
zipFn <- file.path(wddir, "all_summaries.zip")
if (file.exists(zipFn)) {
  cat("[Download all_summaries.zip](all_summaries.zip)\n")
}
```

## Samples {.tabset}

```{r perSample, results='asis'}
for (s in sampleDirs) {
  cat("\n\n### ", s, "\n\n", sep = "")

  ## Link to the native split-pipe analysis summary
  nativeHtml <- paste0(s, "_analysis_summary.html")
  if (file.exists(file.path(wddir, nativeHtml))) {
    cat("[Full split-pipe analysis summary](", nativeHtml, ")\n\n", sep = "")
  }

  ## Per-sample statistics
  statFn <- file.path(wddir, s, "report", "sample_all_stats.csv")
  if (file.exists(statFn)) {
    stat <- read.csv(statFn, check.names = FALSE)
    print(htmltools::tagList(DT::datatable(
      stat,
      caption = paste("Statistics -", s),
      options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE),
      rownames = FALSE
    )))
  }

  ## Figures
  figDir <- file.path(wddir, s, "figures")
  if (dir.exists(figDir)) {
    figs <- sort(list.files(figDir, pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE))
    for (fig in figs) {
      cat("\n\n![", basename(fig), "](", fig, ")\n\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
}
```
